components.name: Primary Action

components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; border: 1px solid var(--primary, #dc2635); border-radius: 0.625rem; background: var(--primary, #dc2635); color: #fff; font: 700 0.75rem/1.5 'Segoe UI Variable', Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -10px rgb(220 38 53 / 0.75), 0 2px 4px rgb(220 38 53 / 0.14); transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #bd1726); border-color: var(--primary-hover, #bd1726); } .ds-primary-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-document-card { position: relative; width: 11.25rem; aspect-ratio: 0.707; overflow: hidden; border: 3px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: #fff; color: var(--text-primary, #20242c); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -8px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.18), 0 2px 5px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.05); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-document-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -24px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.32), 0 8px 20px -12px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.18); } .ds-page-check { position: absolute; top: 0.375rem; left: 0.375rem; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #c8d0da); border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; } .ds-document-lines { display: grid; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 2.5rem 1.25rem; font: 600 0.625rem/1.4 'Segoe UI Variable', Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-document-lines span { display: block; height: 0.375rem; background: var(--surface-subtle, #f7f8fa); } .ds-document-lines span:last-child { width: 68%; } .ds-page-number { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; border-radius: 0 0.375rem 0 0; background: var(--accent, #2563eb); color: #fff; font: 700 0.75rem/1.5 'Segoe UI Variable', Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-workspace-header { display: flex; min-height: 3.75rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color, #dce1e8); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.97); color: var(--text-primary, #20242c); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.06), 0 2px 6px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.03); font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable', Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-brand-mark { display: grid; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; place-items: center; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: var(--primary, #dc2635); color: #fff; } .ds-brand-mark svg { width: 1.25rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-brand-copy { display: grid; margin-right: auto; } .ds-brand-copy strong { font-size: 1rem; } .ds-brand-copy small { color: var(--text-secondary, #596273); font-size: 0.6875rem; } .ds-workspace-header button { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #dce1e8); border-radius: 0.625rem; background: var(--surface-subtle, #f7f8fa); color: var(--text-secondary, #596273); } .ds-workspace-header button:hover { background: #fff; border-color: var(--border-strong, #c8d0da); } .ds-workspace-header button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(100%, 22rem); padding: 1.25rem; border-radius: 1rem; background: #fff; color: var(--text-primary, #20242c); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -24px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.32), 0 8px 20px -12px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.18); font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable', Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0 0 1rem; color: var(--text-secondary, #596273); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-dialog input { width: 100%; height: 2.5rem; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #dce1e8); border-radius: 0.625rem; color: var(--text-primary, #20242c); } .ds-dialog > div { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 1rem; } .ds-dialog button { min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-dialog-cancel { border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #dce1e8); background: #fff; color: var(--text-secondary, #596273); } .ds-dialog-confirm { border: 1px solid var(--primary, #dc2635); background: var(--primary, #dc2635); color: #fff; } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible, .ds-dialog input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
PDF in Place should feel like a well-kept document desk: calm enough for concentrated work, precise enough to inspire trust, and immediately understandable without specialist knowledge. The interface lets the document remain the main artifact while controls form a compact, dependable frame around it.

The system is layered and restrained rather than flat or ornamental. Color, depth, and motion communicate status and hierarchy; they do not decorate empty space. The visual language must avoid promotional, playful, or spectacle-driven patterns that would compete with the user's documents.
keyCharacteristics: Compact controls surrounding a generous document workspace.
Clear separation between primary actions, selection state, and destructive actions.
Quietly tactile interaction with restrained depth and fast feedback.
Responsive composition that preserves every workflow on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Two Accent Rule
rules.body: Document Red owns brand and primary outcomes; Selection Blue owns selection and focus. Never interchange those roles.

rules.name: The Functional Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use size for task hierarchy and weight for control hierarchy; do not add display typography merely to make an operational screen feel branded.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: A surface receives a stronger shadow only when it floats above the workspace, protects focus, or responds to interaction.

dos: Do reserve Document Red for product identity and the primary outcome in each action group.
Do use Selection Blue consistently for focus, active tools, selected pages, and ordered selection.
Do keep controls compact and grouped while leaving generous uninterrupted space around documents.
Do preserve complete workflows on mobile through reflow and horizontal tool bands.
Do use depth only to clarify working layers, interaction, or protected focus.
donts: Don't interchange Document Red and Selection Blue or use both as competing calls to action.
Don't introduce promotional hero patterns, playful decoration, or spectacle-driven motion into operational screens.
Don't place white document pages on an undifferentiated white workspace.
Don't hide essential actions on narrow screens; reflow or provide a clear horizontal scroll affordance.
Don't combine heavy shadows, strong borders, and decorative blur on the same surface.
